test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to make it a meaningful sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

The COVID-19 pandemic __pose innumerable challenges to our education system, and engineering education was no exception. __

options.text: posed innumerable challenges to our education system, and engineering education was no exception.
have been posing innumerable challenges to our education system, and engineering education is not any exception.
posed innumerable challenges to our education system, and engineering education is not a exception.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**posed innumerable challenges to our education system, and engineering education was no exception.**"
